references.text: The children of Reuben and Gad asked to settle east of the Jordan, which is the background for Joshua's speech to these tribes.
Moses gave the land east of the Jordan to the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and half of Manasseh, a fact now confirmed by Joshua.
Moses reminds them that he gave the land east of the Jordan to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh.
Reference to the territories given as an inheritance to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh.
Joshua reminds the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh of Moses' command to help the other tribes before returning to their own lands.
The children of Reuben and Gad, along with half the tribe of Manasseh, crossed the Jordan armed ahead of the Israelites.
Description of the inheritance that the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh received east of the Jordan.
Gad, Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh had already received their inheritance on the east side of the Jordan.
